_comment: BREACHPOINT - blockout CONSTRUCTION profile (Tools/blockout/, ticket BP07).
These are BUILD constants, not gameplay tuning: how thick a deck slab is, how big a
'chest' crate is, what the eye height used for the static sightline test is. They live
here because arena_manifest.json does not name them (see contract_gaps in the BP07 Log)
and because a number a script needs must be reviewable text, never a literal buried in
code. They are NOT law-3 tuning values: nothing here is read at runtime by the game.
The KICKOFF THRESHOLDS (>=8 spawns, >=8 m spacing, <=35 m sightline, named rocket node)
are deliberately NOT in this file. They are the ticket's acceptance numbers and live as
constants in arena_plan.py so that no profile override can quietly weaken a gate.
Units are metres everywhere. The metre -> centimetre conversion happens exactly once,
in arena_plan.M_TO_CM, at the editor boundary.

lighting.note: Test lighting only - player-clamped blockout readability, not an art pass (BP07 out-of-scope: art dressing).
